About the role
We are setting up a finance shared service centre in Warsaw for our European entities and are looking for an interim lead for group reporting during the ramp-up phase.

Responsibilities
Lead the monthly consolidation and group reporting for 38 legal entities under IFRS
Build up and train a team of 12 accountants on site
Migrate the reporting from legacy tools to SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting
Act as the key contact for the group CFO and the external auditors

Requirements
10+ years of experience in group reporting and consolidation under IFRS
Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA
Project management experience in finance transformation projects
Fluent English, Polish is a strong plus

Terms
B2B contract for 9 months, start in October 2026
Day rate EUR 1,100
On site in Warsaw, five days per week, relocation support available
Remote work is not possible for this role
